```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(plotly)

# Canva website insights exports for The Collins Concierge (last 12 weeks).
# File names are export timestamps, so sorting them keeps issue order.
files <- list.files("data/concierge-canva", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) |>
  sort()

raw_files    <- tibble(file = files, md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(files)))
unique_files <- raw_files |> distinct(md5, .keep_all = TRUE)   # drop byte-identical duplicates
n_files <- nrow(raw_files)
n_dupes <- n_files - nrow(unique_files)

issues <- unique_files |>
  mutate(issue = row_number(),
         data  = map(file, read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
  select(issue, data) |>
  unnest(data)

issue_summary <- issues |>
  group_by(issue) |>
  summarise(
    views       = sum(Count[Dimension == "country"]),
    mobile      = sum(Count[Dimension == "device" & Name == "Mobile"]),
    link_clicks = sum(Count[Dimension == "link"]),
    rkr_clicks  = sum(Count[Dimension == "link" & str_detect(Name, "cpp\\.edu/rkr")]),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(ctr = rkr_clicks / views,
         rkr_share = rkr_clicks / link_clicks)

pooled_ctr   <- sum(issue_summary$rkr_clicks) / sum(issue_summary$views)
mobile_share <- sum(issue_summary$mobile) / sum(issue_summary$views)

pct <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
green <- "#16804A"; gold <- "#B87A00"; gray <- "#8A8F98"
```

## Row {height=78%}

```{r}
#| title: "RKR click rate by issue (dashed line = pooled baseline)"
plot_ly(issue_summary, x = ~factor(issue), y = ~ctr, type = "bar",
        marker = list(color = green),
        text = ~rkr_clicks, textposition = "outside",
        hovertemplate = "Issue %{x}<br>Click rate: %{y:.1%}<br>RKR clicks: %{text}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Concierge issue (oldest to newest)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "RKR clicks ÷ page views", tickformat = ".1%"),
         shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1,
                            y0 = pooled_ctr, y1 = pooled_ctr,
                            line = list(color = gold, width = 2, dash = "dash"))),
         annotations = list(list(xref = "paper", x = 1, y = pooled_ctr, xanchor = "right",
                                 yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE,
                                 text = paste("Pooled baseline:", pct(pooled_ctr)))),
         bargap = 0.35)
```

::: {.card title="What the baseline shows"}
```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(sprintf(
"- **%d issues, %s page views.** That is about **%d views per issue**.\n- **%d clicks reached RKR pages** (cpp.edu/rkr), a pooled click rate of **%s**.\n- **%d issues had zero RKR clicks.** The best issue reached **%s**.\n- **%s of views came from mobile**, so the RKR section has to work on a phone screen.\n\nThis is the pre-test baseline. The Fall test moves the \"Reserve a Table\" button to the upper left and compares new issues against these numbers.",
  nrow(issue_summary), format(sum(issue_summary$views), big.mark = ","),
  round(mean(issue_summary$views)),
  sum(issue_summary$rkr_clicks), pct(pooled_ctr),
  sum(issue_summary$rkr_clicks == 0), pct(max(issue_summary$ctr)),
  pct(mobile_share, 0)))
```
:::

# Audience and Links

## Row {height=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Page views by issue"
plot_ly(issue_summary, x = ~factor(issue), y = ~views, type = "bar",
        marker = list(color = green),
        hovertemplate = "Issue %{x}<br>Views: %{y}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Concierge issue"), yaxis = list(title = "Page views"),
         bargap = 0.35)
```

```{r}
#| title: "RKR's share of all link clicks"
plot_ly(issue_summary, x = ~factor(issue), y = ~rkr_share, type = "bar",
        marker = list(color = gold),
        customdata = ~paste(rkr_clicks, "of", link_clicks),
        hovertemplate = "Issue %{x}<br>%{y:.1%} of link clicks (%{customdata})<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Concierge issue"),
         yaxis = list(title = "RKR clicks ÷ all link clicks", tickformat = ".0%"),
         bargap = 0.35)
```

## Row {height=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Where views came from (all issues)"
sources <- issues |>
  filter(Dimension == "source") |>
  group_by(Name) |> summarise(views = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(views)) |>
  mutate(Name = if_else(row_number() <= 5, Name, "Other")) |>
  group_by(Name) |> summarise(views = sum(views), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(views) |>
  mutate(Name = factor(Name, levels = Name))
plot_ly(sources, y = ~Name, x = ~views, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        marker = list(color = green),
        hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x} views<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Page views"), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Most clicked links (all issues)"
links <- issues |>
  filter(Dimension == "link") |>
  mutate(Name = str_remove(Name, "^https?://(www\\.)?") |> str_remove("/$")) |>
  group_by(Name) |> summarise(clicks = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(clicks)) |> slice_head(n = 10) |>
  mutate(is_rkr = str_detect(Name, "cpp\\.edu/rkr"),
         label  = str_trunc(Name, 45)) |>
  arrange(clicks) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = unique(label)))
plot_ly(links, y = ~label, x = ~clicks, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        marker = list(color = ~if_else(is_rkr, gold, gray)),
        customdata = ~Name,
        hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<br>%{x} clicks<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Clicks"), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

# Next Tests

## Row

::: {.card title="Analytics Objective 1: Newsletter Design and Reservation Growth"}
**Goal:** compare RKR click rates and attributed OpenTable reservations across section designs, changing one element per phase.

| Phase | What changes | Compared against |
|-------|--------------|------------------|
| Fall 2026 | "Reserve a Table" button moves to the upper left | This baseline (past issues) |
| Spring 2027 | Image vs. video, button fixed in the upper left | Each other |

**Methods**

- **Two-proportion z-test:** compares click rates between conditions at α = 0.05.
- **Independent-samples t-test:** compares average weekly attributed OpenTable reservations between designs.

**Not yet available:** issue dates, the first upper-left-button issue, and OpenTable reservations by link. These pages will add the comparisons once that data comes in.
:::
